blurb: Projects in the home. The Store's engine and machine come from the Store.
reasons: Why hide_path: an agent meeting remove_file cold will use it like file.rm, and hide a path from the project's whole history.
Why stats has no commit: the caller named the Branch or --at; the Commit it counted is in the long form.

Why sizes are opt-in on the list: a file count and a size per project need a count kept at publish, or a tree walk that comes back partial for any repo with node_modules. project list --with stats asks for them; project get takes no --with.
Why file_count, not files: a plural noun is always a list, so a number is never named with one.
Why only a project has two doctor depths: the shallow check reads records; --full reads the data its Branches reach, which can take minutes.

calls.new_work: `state` and its companions (`op`, `blocked_by`, `reason`, `fix`) are new: a project has no state today. They come from the home's records (the Store's and its machine's state, a recorded delete or Init), with no probe. Listing the projects of a Store that cannot be opened is new: today an all-Stores listing leaves that Store out and a named one is refused. `commit` (main's head) per row is new in the answer: the listing already reads each project's stack record, which holds it, but keeps only the name and stack id, and the worker's listing reply does not carry it. `--with stats` is new: no call lists a size per project today, and a file count needs a count kept at publish (`project.stats` walks the tree and can stop at its work bound). `--cursor` is new: today the call pages by position (`page_size`, `page_pos`, default 50). The cursor must carry the Commit the first page read and the call's filters.

calls.note: shallow: its record (project.record) and its record against the Store's own list (project.listed); --full also reads everything reachable from main's head and each Branch's head (project.data). A project on record that the Store does not list is a notice with the fix layerfs project delete <project>, not an error. A not_checked entry carries blocked_by or reason (timeout, busy, lost). The answer is the one doctor shape; the project node's coverage is shallow, full with --full, or none when it could not be checked

calls.new_work: The call and its answer shape are new. The record check is not: `project.get` and `project.list` already compare a project's record with the Store's own list (and hide a project the Store does not list); the doctor reports that case as a notice with a fix. `--full` is new work: a streamed, bounded-memory, read-only walk of everything reachable from main's head and the head of each Branch, on both engines and through a machine's worker; today's integrity check has no scope smaller than a Store. Progress events are new. The fix `layerfs project delete <project>` finishes a delete that kept the home's entry; no call today removes the entry of a project that was deleted from another home.
